subject: Request: Tranche/fractional reserved capacity + onramp plan for OrionAI (APAC/EU/US)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@orionai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tranche/fractional reserved capacity + onramp plan for OrionAI (APAC/EU/US)

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our call, OrionAI expects a stepped ramp across APAC then EU with a smaller US footprint initially. To keep your unit economics predictable while you scale, we want to propose a tranche/fractional reserved model (partial dedicated pools per region) + a 12-week onramp schedule.

I attached an initial capacity model (orion_capacity_model_v4.xlsx) with three scenarios: conservative (burst-first), balanced (fractional reserve), and aggressive (dedicated tranche). Can you confirm these items so we can finalize a Mutual Action Plan (MAP)?

- expected sustained token QPS per minute (peak 95th) by region
- max concurrent requests (seq length assumptions: 1k tokens typical?)
- strict data residency or private deployment needs
- preferred contract cadence (monthly tranche vs. quarterly)

If you can send the QPS numbers by Tuesday EOD PST we’ll produce a short MAP and rollout timeline for review. Karthik/Marcus — tagging you for feasibility/constraints on GCP quotas and short-term burst capacity.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Regional Deals (APAC & EU)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: orion_capacity_model_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet, model scenarios)
From: Priya Shah <priya@orionai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: OrionAI Procurement <procure@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tranche/fractional reserved capacity + onramp plan for OrionAI (APAC/EU/US)

Soojin —

Appreciate the spreadsheet. Quick answers below (rough numbers for scoping):
- APAC: expected sustained ~45k tokens/min (95th peak ~85k) starting wk2 of onramp
- EU: sustained ~20k tokens/min, peak ~35k (we expect slower ramp after APAC)
- US: pilot traffic ~6k tokens/min, can remain burst-only for Q1
- Concurrent requests: APAC 220, EU 80, US 25 (avg seq length ~700 tokens)

Residency: APAC and EU must be regionally isolated (data at rest). We can use hosted Dedicated with customer-managed keys if needed. Contract cadence: prefer monthly tranches for the first 3 months, then re-evaluate.

Could you include an explicit fallback policy in the MAP (burst to hosted variant) and a contingency for GCP region quotas? Procurement wants a simple ramp schedule and pricing per tranche.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, OrionAI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tranche/fractional reserved capacity + onramp plan for OrionAI (APAC/EU/US)

Soojin/Priya —

Thanks for the numbers, Priya. Quick feasibility notes from the sales side:
- The APAC 85k token/min 95th is sizable but fits a fractional pool model if we combine prefix caching + intelligent batching. Cost can be kept near hosted rates with a 40% discount vs pure on-demand if they commit to a 3-month tranche.
- EU isolation is straightforward with a small dedicated tranche (1-2 rack-equivalents) for the first quarter.
- US pilot: recommend keeping on-demand burst routing to avoid committed spend.

Ask: Marcus — can the ops team provision a 3-tranche plan in GCP Singapore, Dublin, and us-west1 with burst fallback to hosted within 24 hours? We should also validate GCP regional GPU availability for the proposed window (wk2 APAC ramp).

I'll draft pricing bands for monthly tranches and include token-unit economics by scenario.

-Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tranche/fractional reserved capacity + onramp plan for OrionAI (APAC/EU/US)

Team —

I pulled capacity constraints and attached a short note (gcp_region_limits.pdf) and a revised capacity workbook (orion_capacity_model_v4.xlsx, updated with realistic instance mixes). Key operational points:
- Singapore (asia-southeast1) has limited A100 availability in week 6-8 of our booking window — to guarantee APAC 85k tokens/min 95th we'll need either: (A) a mix of quantized 8-bit instances + caching, or (B) temporarily spill to hosted GPUs in a nearby region with low-latency egress routing.
- Dublin look ok for the small EU tranche but quota request should start immediately (30-day lead).
- us-west1: keep burst-only; no committed nodes until Q2.

I propose the onramp:
Week 0-2: validation + performance labs (hosted)
Week 3-5: APAC fractional tranche live (quantized profile)
Week 6-8: add EU dedicated tranche (small) + quota confirmations
Week 9-12: evaluation and top-up optional tranche for APAC if peak holds

I attached the updated workbook and a short GCP note.

-Marcus

Attachments: orion_capacity_model_v4.xlsx (revised), gcp_region_limits.pdf (ops note)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@orionai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Tranche/fractional reserved capacity + onramp plan for OrionAI (APAC/EU/US)

Priya —

Thanks — based on the ops constraints Marcus called out, here’s a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) summary and next steps. I attached a formal MAP doc as well (orion_mutual_action_plan.docx). Please review and confirm sign-off items below: 

MAP summary (high level):
- Commitment: monthly tranche for months 1-3; initial tranche sizes: APAC fractional ~60% reserved capacity equivalent, EU small dedicated tranche, US burst-only.
- Onramp timeline: validation (0-2w) -> APAC fractional (3-5w) -> EU dedicated (6-8w) -> optional top-up (9-12w).
- Fallbacks: automatic reroute to hosted instance-family variant if regional GPU quotas prevent instant provisioning; documented SLA for fallback latency and cost uplift in MAP.
- Security: APAC & EU data-at-rest isolation; KMS integration option (we will include an HSM addendum if requested).
- Pricing: Karthik to send tranche pricing bands (monthly) and expected per-token unit economics for each scenario.

Action items and owners:
- OrionAI: confirm QPS/peak numbers (Priya) by Tue 02/27 EOD PST — will be used to lock tranche sizes.
- Redwood Ops: Marcus to start GCP quota requests for Dublin and Singapore and validate immediate availability window.
- Redwood Sales: Karthik to produce tranche pricing and send a short commercial summary.
- Redwood Legal/Finance: Rishi to prep standard tranche SOW + billing cadence (monthly invoices).

If that looks good I’ll convert this into a signed MAP and circulate. Priya — could you confirm the QPS table by Tue EOD? We’ll plan a 1-hour alignment call next Mon to finalize SOW.

Thanks,
Soojin
(end of thread)
